highlights.title: Nigeria’s Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Exit From Country
highlights.description: Nigeria’s antitrust commission said it is probing Uber Technologies Inc.’s abrupt exit from the West African nation, after the ride-hailing platform shut down last week without prior notice to users.
